newsitem.title: FRANCE: No turning back on democracy in Benin-Kerekou.
newsitem.headline: No turning back on democracy in Benin-Kerekou.

text.p: Benin President Mathieu Kerekou said during an official visit to France on Thursday that democracy was irreversible in his West African nation.

"Benin, a revolutionary country yesterday, is today a democratic nation, and there is no possibility of returning to the past," Kerekou told UNESCO member states at the U.N. agency's Paris headquarters.
Kerekou was on his first visit to Europe since his comeback presidential election victory last March.
He had first come to power in a military coup d'etat in 1972 but later made the transition to democracy and to a market economy. He was defeated for re-election in March 1991.
